2609.30763.title: HCOE: Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings from Biomedical Language Models
2609.30763.paper_summary: Biomedical language models (LMs) encode textual semantics but do not explicitly preserve medical code hierarchies. We present Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings (HCOE) for hierarchy-aware clinical concept representation. HCOE maps frozen BioBERT embeddings into a Poincare ball, combining parent-side and child-side ontology-guided contrastive learning with coarse-to-fine ontology-path aggregation. It uses International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes organized by Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) and Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) medication hierarchies. Evaluations show that HCOE performs best on ICD/ATC clinical relation prediction and CCS-to-PheCode hierarchy transfer. On the MIMIC-IV dataset, HCOE also achieves the best performance on mortality prediction, readmission prediction, medication recommendation, and rare drug prediction.
2609.30763.paper_summary_zh: 生物醫學語言模型（LMs）編碼文本語義，但並未明確保留醫療代碼層級。我們提出了超曲率臨床本體嵌入（HCOE），用於層級感知的臨床概念表示。HCOE 將凍結的 BioBERT 嵌入映射到 Poincare 球中，結合了父側和子側的本體引導對比學習以及粗到細的本體路徑聚合。它使用由臨床分類軟體（CCS）和解剖治療化學（ATC）藥物層級組織的國際疾病分類（ICD）代碼。評估顯示，HCOE 在 ICD/ATC 臨床關係預測和 CCS 到 PheCode 層級轉移方面表現最佳。在 MIMIC-IV 數據集中，HCOE 在死亡預測、再入院預測、藥物推薦和罕見藥物預測方面也達到了最佳性能。
